text:
maya: Quick sync planning runtime 2.19 roll at 01:00 UTC. Kernel reorder + kv-pointer patch. Need pin strategy for embed/* and longseq models.

tony: Suggest soft-hold embed/* -> 2.18 for 3h after roll. We've seen transient cost blips before.

sasha: Canary: small p95 bump for longseq-quant but no error spike. Attaching short repro. Not blocking.

dana: Are we requiring SDK 3.5.2 for new header? If so we should add fallback snippet.

ops-oncall: Recommend deadman revert at 04:00 UTC. Auto-revert if 5xx > 1.2% or p95 +30% sustained 8m.

deploybot: Snapshotting pinlist at 00:30 UTC. Preview diff:
```
- runtime_pin: 2.18 -> models: [core-chat/*]
+ runtime_pin: 2.19 -> models: [nlp-express/*]
+ soft_pin: embed/* -> 2.18 until 04:00 UTC
```

maya: Decision: apply soft_pin for embed/* only. Action items:
- sasha: post canary repro + traces by 00:10.
- dana: add SDK fallback note by 00:15.
- deploybot: apply soft_pin at 00:30 and publish diff.
- ops-oncall: enable deadman revert at 04:00.

dana: Fallback snippet for notes:
```
client:
  runtime_preference: ["2.19","2.18"]
```

sasha: Canary repro: `summarize 10k token doc` shows warmup lag on first chunk.

deploybot: Confirmed: soft_pin applied at 00:30 UTC. Roll scheduled 01:00 UTC.

ops-oncall: I'll run embed smoke post-roll and watch rates. Will page if revert triggers.

maya: Thanks all. If any correctness regressions show up, post here and tag me. We'll hold more unpins until 08:00 UTC.
